feed.title: Security Advisory for .NET packages hosted at the NuGet Gallery
feed.subtitle: Security Advisory for .NET packages hosted at the NuGet Gallery on GitHub

entry.title: [Magick.NET-Q8-x86] ImageMagick has a Heap Buffer Over-Write in SF3 encoder when writing multi-frame image
entry.content:
An crafted multi-frame can result in a heap buffer over-write when encoding it with the SF3 encoder.

References

  • https://github.com/ImageMagick/ImageMagick/security/advisories/GHSA-44cp-c3ww-9rv5
  • https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-53465
  • https://github.com/dlemstra/Magick.NET/releases/tag/14.14.0
  • https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-44cp-c3ww-9rv5
